notablePrerequisites:
Heronblade Elite and Niblis do not have summoning sickness.
Heronblade Elite has a power of four or greater.
description:
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Niblis by paying {U} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Niblis' ability, targeting Heronblade Elite.
Resolve both Niblis abilities, untapping Niblis and Heronblade Elite.
Repeat.
